title: Integrative multi-omics analysis proposes a metabolic classification of gliomas: distinct metabolic states, immune infiltration, and prognosis.
summary: Multi-omics and machine learning define glioma metabolic subtypes, with metabolomic and single-nucleus RNA-seq data supporting differences in metabolic states, immune infiltration and prognosis. This is a specific measured multi-omics characterization, with observational limits.
ai_technology: Multi-omics clustering and machine learning define glioma metabolic subtypes, compared with metabolomic and single-nucleus RNA evidence.
